rubrics.criteria: Rejects in Article 4, Section 4.3 AgentCo’s insertion of “(iii) after human review of Results of Service;”
rubrics.justification: This edit is unclear in the broader context of the sentence and clause so it should be removed to avoid ambiguity.

rubrics.criteria: Accepts in Article 5, Section 5.1 AgentCo’s insertion of “applicable”
rubrics.justification: This term is not necessary given the language already covers the ‘covenants in this Section,’ however, it does no harm, so GiantCo can accept in an effort to close the deal quicker.

rubrics.criteria: Accepts in Article 6, Section 6.1 AgentCo’s insertion of “candidate-material summaries and interview-note drafting”
rubrics.justification: This language is an accurate description of AgentCo’s Services, so accepting the language here is logical.

rubrics.criteria: Rejects in Article 6, Section 6.1 AgentCo’s insertion of “(collectively the “Services)”
rubrics.justification: The term “Services” is already defined so this should be removed to avoid ambiguity.

rubrics.criteria: Accepts in Article 6, Section 6.2 AgentCo’s deletion of “Consultant may be provided access to Client’s “proprietary” (See “Confidentiality of Client Information” below) website wherein Consultant may obtain access to Client’s current Guidelines, Policies, Protocols, Processes, Specifications, including Client’s Travel Policies for Consultants and other requirements”
rubrics.justification: It’s not clear that this is something GiantCo offers to its vendors; the remainder of the clause is sufficient to ensure AgentCo complies with such policies.
"Worldwide" is clearer and more widely accepted than the alternative terms "everywhere" or "at mutual locations" proposed earlier in negotiations.

rubrics.criteria: Rejects in Article 7, Section 7.5 AgentCo’s insertion of “at mutual locations”
rubrics.justification: The license being granted “at mutual locations” is vague and should be removed and clarified with alternative language.

rubrics.criteria: Accepts in Article 7, Section 7.5 AgentCo’s deletion of “everywhere”
rubrics.justification: The license being granted “everywhere” is vague and should be removed and clarified with alternative language.

rubrics.criteria: Accepts in Article 7, Section 7.5 AgentCo’s deletion of “irrevocable”
rubrics.justification: AgentCo has pushed back on the license being irrevocable, stating that it needs to be revocable if GiantCo were to breach this agreement, which is fair.

rubrics.criteria: Accepts in Article 15, Section 15.12 AgentCo’s insertion of “OBLIGATION TO PAY UNDISPUTED AMOUNTS DUE AND OWING UNDER THIS AGREEMENT; (C) EITHER PARTY'S INFRINGEMENT OR MISAPPROPRIATION OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; OR (D) EITHER PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS WITH RESPECT TO THIRD-PARTY CLAIMS UNDER THIS AGREEMENT”
rubrics.justification: These carve outs from the limitation of liability cap provide adequate assurances for both parties that the other party is not exempt from its liability obligations in these common circumstances.
